nak.page.title: The 27 Nakshatras
nak.page.desc: The Nakshatras are the 27 traditional "lunar mansions" of Vedic astrology, each with its own ruling deity, planet, symbol, and character.
nak.page.note: This is an educational reference and manual-selection tool, not a calculator — your true birth Nakshatra depends on the Moon's precise position at your exact birth time, which requires real ephemeris data we don't compute here. If you already know your Nakshatra from a Vedic birth chart, find it below.

nak.ashwini.name: Ashwini
nak.ashwini.desc: Ashwini is traditionally associated with speed, healing, and new beginnings — the first Nakshatra, said to carry the energy of a fresh start.
nak.bharani.name: Bharani
nak.bharani.deity: Yama, god of death and dharma
nak.bharani.desc: Bharani carries themes of transformation, restraint, and the full cycle of life and death.
nak.krittika.name: Krittika
nak.krittika.desc: Krittika is traditionally associated with sharp discernment and purifying fire.
nak.rohini.name: Rohini
nak.rohini.desc: Rohini is considered one of the most auspicious Nakshatras, traditionally linked to beauty, fertility, and material growth.
nak.mrigashira.name: Mrigashira
nak.mrigashira.desc: Mrigashira means 'deer's head' and traditionally represents gentle searching and curiosity.
nak.ardra.name: Ardra
nak.ardra.desc: Ardra is associated with storms, upheaval, and the intense transformation that follows destruction.
nak.punarvasu.name: Punarvasu
nak.punarvasu.desc: Punarvasu means 'return of the light' and is traditionally tied to renewal, optimism, and safe return.
nak.pushya.name: Pushya
nak.pushya.desc: Pushya is widely considered one of the most auspicious Nakshatras in Vedic tradition, associated with nourishment.
nak.ashlesha.name: Ashlesha
nak.ashlesha.desc: Ashlesha is traditionally linked to serpent symbolism — penetrating insight, hypnotic charm, and hidden knowledge.
nak.detail.subtitle: Nakshatra #{order}
nak.detail.disclaimer: This is a traditional, educational reference — not a calculation from your date of birth. Your actual birth Nakshatra depends on the Moon's exact sidereal position at your birth time.

num.desc.lifePath.1: You're a natural-born leader with a pioneering spirit — independent, ambitious, and allergic to being told what to do.
num.desc.lifePath.2: You are the diplomat of the numbers, wired for partnership, harmony, and emotional intuition.
num.desc.lifePath.3: Creativity, charm, and self-expression are your calling cards. You light up rooms with words, art, or humor.
num.desc.lifePath.4: You're the builder — practical, disciplined, and deeply trustworthy.
num.desc.lifePath.5: Freedom is oxygen to you. You crave change, travel, new people, and new experiences.
num.desc.lifePath.6: You're the nurturer, wired for responsibility, family, and service to others.
num.desc.lifePath.7: You're the seeker — analytical, private, and drawn to the deeper questions beneath the surface of things.
num.desc.lifePath.8: Power, ambition, and material mastery define your path. You understand money, authority, and systems intuitively.
num.desc.lifePath.9: You're the humanitarian, here to give more than you take. Compassion, big-picture vision, and a pull toward causes larger than yourself define you.
num.desc.lifePath.11: A master number — you're a highly intuitive visionary, wired like a spiritual antenna picking up what others miss.
num.desc.lifePath.22: The master builder — you combine the practical grit of a 4 with the vision of an 11, giving you the rare ability to turn big dreams into tangible, lasting reality.
num.desc.lifePath.33: The master teacher — a rare path defined by selfless love, healing, and guidance for others.
num.desc.destiny.1: Your destiny is to lead. You're meant to innovate and start things others are too afraid to attempt.
num.desc.destiny.9: Your destiny is service on a broad scale. You're meant to give back — through art, activism, teaching, or compassion.
num.desc.soulUrge.3: Your soul craves joy, play, and expression. You want to be seen and appreciated for your creativity and charm.
num.desc.personality.4: People see you as dependable and grounded, the one they call when they need something done right.
